annotations.title: Create or edit a DAO wiki page

description: Create or edit a page on a DAO's company-layer wiki. Holders only – any amount of the DAO's token, its vote token or its founder badge. Pass the body as `html`, one HTML string that becomes a standard content block (headings, paragraphs, lists, tables), or as `blocks`, the block tree the site's editor saves. To edit an existing page, read it with get_page and `blocks: true` on the DAO's MCP server, revise those blocks, and pass its `version` as `baseVersion`: a page someone else changed since is refused rather than overwritten. `newSlug` moves an existing page to another slug in its tag path, with its history. Requires the Bearer token from the `login` tool, sent as an HTTP `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header on the POST carrying this call.

baseVersion.description: the version the page's get_page read returned; a page changed since is refused with 409 (omit for a new page)
